name: Los Balagueses

climate: Tempranillo and Merlot sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

terms: A wine from a pago, a named rural site with its own soil and microclimate. All its grapes must grow there.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: A single-estate Vino de Pago in Requena, Valencia. Allowed grapes include Tempranillo, Merlot, Syrah and Bobal for red, and Chardonnay, Sauvignon Blanc and Tardana for white.
